createConnection.title: Create connection ...
createConnection.text:
Travel finds its meaning in encounters: with places, cultures, people, different rhythms.

Atlantis 12 is a space for sharing, presence and attention. Here, we take time to converse, to understand, to listen. Around a table, a fire, a workshop or a walk in the garden, connections form naturally.

We invite you to be fully present, to savor each moment, to let yourself be carried by the simplicity and authenticity of exchanges. For it is these invisible connections that make a stay unforgettable.
createConnection.quote: Thank you for your understanding and for your attention to the harmony we cultivate every day.

preserveRare.title: Preserve what is rare ...
preserveRare.text:
Atlantis 12 is a charming ecolodge nestled in a protected natural park, committed to environmental respect and sustainable tourism.

Our approach to tourism is conscious and measured, mindful of the fragility of the place. We invite you to participate, through simple daily gestures and attentions: preserving essential resources - water, energy, silence, living things.

Closing taps, turning off lights, respecting the rhythms of the place… So many small gestures that preserve the delicate balance of this space.
preserveRare.quote: Thank you for honoring with us the delicate balance of this place.

welcomeHarmony.title: Welcome in harmony ...
welcomeHarmony.text:
To preserve the tranquility and peaceful atmosphere of the premises, we welcome children from 12 years old.

The house is already home to dogs, cats and chickens, which contribute to the living balance of the place. We therefore cannot accommodate other animals.

These choices help preserve a serene and respectful atmosphere, for everyone and for the welcoming place.
welcomeHarmony.quote: Because it is often these invisible bonds that make a stay unforgettable.

roomsIntro.title: The accommodations at Atlantis 12
roomsIntro.lead: a sanctuary of calm and beauty
roomsIntro.text: Nestled among the trees and within a restored Berber sheepfold, our guesthouse in Essaouira offers unique suites and rooms, combining modern comfort with authenticity. In these bright spaces, featuring fireplaces, terraces or private patios, stone and wood blend with a bohemian and artistic décor. Whether you choose an intimate small suite or a spacious superior room, each accommodation is designed to offer calm, elegance, and conviviality. The typical stone walls of Essaouira bring warmth and character, while the windows and glass doors open onto the garden, the pool, or the thuya forest, inviting relaxation and contemplation. A refined setting, inspired by art and nature, for an unforgettable stay in Essaouira.

aboutPage.seoDesc: The story of Atlantis 12, a guesthouse near Essaouira-haven of calm, creativity and hospitality.
paragraphs: This is how Atlantis 12 was born - a guesthouse nestled in the Essaouira countryside, envisioned as a refuge for travelers seeking peace, beauty, and meaning.

Tucked inside a lovingly restored former Berber sheepfold, Atlantis 12 unfolds across one hectare of preserved nature, between thuya forests, Atlantic light, birdsong, and soothing silence. A charming retreat, far from the hustle and bustle, yet just minutes from the medina and the sea.
Asmae has infused the place with her gift for hospitality, her attention to detail, and her desire to offer a heartfelt welcome, rooted in Moroccan tradition and the joy of sharing.

Lahcen, for his part, has shaped the space with his artistic soul and sensibility: textures, materials, volumes, and carefully chosen objects converse to create a unique and inspiring atmosphere - ideal for both creative flow and restful retreat.
Atlantis 12 is far more than a place to stay - it’s a haven, a restorative experience, a pause.
A space to reconnect with yourself, with nature, with your creativity.
A living, evolving place - open to encounters, emotions, and silence.

table.title: The Guest Table
table.p1: The guest table lies at the heart of the Atlantis 12 experience: a moment of conviviality, generosity, and culinary discovery.
table.p2: Inspired by Andalusian, Berber, and Jewish traditions, our cuisine highlights the richness of Moroccan gastronomy and the freshness of local products. Each meal is born from the garden, the market, or the catch of the day, respecting both the ingredients and the rhythm of the seasons.
table.p3: Around a large convivial table or in a more intimate setting, our guests enjoy fragrant couscous, slow-cooked tagines, grilled fish, colorful salads, and homemade pastries.
table.p4: Each meal is conceived as a unique creation, guided by the season, daily arrivals, and the inspiration of our chefs.
table.p5: For this reason, our dinners are offered by reservation only, allowing us to provide a fresh, sincere, and generous cuisine, faithful to the spirit of Atlantis 12.

maison.title: The Guest House
maison.subtitle: The spirit of Essaouira - silence, beauty and warmth
maison.p1: Born from the shared dream of Asmae and Lahcen, Atlantis 12 is a guesthouse located in the Essaouira region of Morocco, nestled between wild nature and the ocean. More than accommodation, it is a sensitive and artistic experience where every detail tells a story.
maison.p2: In this haven inspired by Berber traditions, traditional architecture blends with the shifting light of Essaouira. Artworks created or exhibited on site converse with the simple, warm gestures of hospitality.
maison.p3: At Atlantis 12, silence soothes, beauty inspires, and every stay becomes a moment of sharing, creativity, or contemplation.
maison.p4: Whether you’re seeking an authentic stay, a retreat, or an artistic place by the sea, our guest house opens its doors to you with heart.
maison.quote:
Between the wind and the stone,
there is
a silence that inspires.
maison.footer: Here, everything is shared: the light, the bread, and the peace of the place.

maisonDArt.title: The House of Art
maisonDArt.subtitle: If hospitality is the first face of Atlantis 12, art is its beating heart.
maisonDArt.p1:
Behind the rooms and gardens, Atlantis also asserts itself as a House of Art, where creativity is lived, shared, and celebrated every day.
Paintings, sculptures, unique objects and music interact with the stone and light of Essaouira, infusing the place with an atmosphere that is both inspiring and soothing.
maisonDArt.p2: The studio regularly welcomes artists in residence, open to experimentation and encounters, and Lahcen offers intuitive painting workshops to invite everyone to explore their imagination.
maisonDArt.p3: Exhibitions, spontaneous concerts and jazz evenings punctuate life at Atlantis, transforming each stay into a cultural and sensory experience.
maisonDArt.p4:
To extend the emotion beyond the stay, some artworks are available for purchase:
a fragment of Atlantis 12 to take home.
maisonDArt.tagline:
Thus, Atlantis 12 brings together two vocations:
a haven of calm and beauty, and a place of living creation where hospitality and art respond to and enrich one another.

activites.title: Experiences
activites.subtitle: An invitation to unique and meaningful moments.
activites.p1: During the day, you can rejuvenate by the pool, wander through the garden, surrender to a massage beneath the argan trees, dream away on the rooftop facing the immensity of the forest, or explore your creativity during an intuitive painting workshop.
activites.p2: The more adventurous set out to discover Essaouira and its surroundings: sunset horseback rides, camel treks to the wild beaches, surfing or kitesurfing on the best spots of the Atlantic coast, quad excursions through the countryside and dunes, or leisurely strolls through the medina and its Moroccan craft boutiques.
activites.p3: At nightfall, the atmosphere shifts: Lahcen sometimes picks up his guitar to improvise a musical moment with friends; on other evenings, the star-filled sky puts on a magical show from the terrace; and when the desire to go out calls, we happily share our best local addresses to enjoy Essaouira’s vibrant evenings.
activites.p4:
Atlantis 12 is the ideal starting point to blend relaxation, creativity and discovery.
A guesthouse in Essaouira designed to experience life differently - at the rhythm of your desires.

geneseParas: The dream of Asmae and Lahcen, for whom art, gastronomy and Moroccan hospitality are ways of being in the world and offering its very best.
Atlantis 12 was not built. It was dreamt, then slowly revealed, stone by stone, painting by painting, silence by silence.

It all began with a love at first sight for a place lost between sky and scrubland, a few kilometres from Essaouira. A wild, forgotten place, swept by the Atlantic wind and the golden southern light. A place that was waiting.

For years, we tamed this place, awakened its stones, mastered its volumes, deepened its silence. Until it became what it is today: a guesthouse and house of art where each room bears the name of a plant, like so many secret gardens, each with its own soul.
Meals are taken at the heart of art or beneath the thuyas. Mornings smell of argan, msemmen and warm bread. Nights are silent, starlit, absolute.
We welcome only adults, by choice, to preserve the quality of silence and connection that makes the soul of Atlantis 12.
essenceParas: There is another way of travelling. Not the one of interchangeable hotels, of folkloric scenery calibrated to please everyone and that ends up touching no one. A slower, truer way, where you arrive somewhere and feel, without needing to be told, that you are expected.
It is this conviction that founded Atlantis 12.
An old sheepfold lovingly transformed. Its walls carry a story, its rooms hold a memory, its plants have a name. Nothing has been placed for effect. Everything is here because we love it.

Essaouira is not our backdrop. It is our material. The particular light of this city - white in the morning, golden in the evening, never quite the same - enters through our windows and tints each hour differently. The trade winds carry the scent of the Atlantic into the rooms. The medina pulses gently a few minutes' drive away, close enough to dive into, far enough to return from soothed. The cuisine we prepare comes from this land, this sea, these three cultures intertwined for centuries: Amazigh, Andalusian, Sephardic.

Art runs through the house like a continuous thread. The works we exhibit, the artists we welcome, from here and elsewhere, from Morocco and the world, make Atlantis 12 a living place, in motion, where creation is never an ornament but always a presence.

Nature, for its part, needs no announcement. It enters through scents, through light, through the breath of the wind, through birdsong. It reminds us that time here moves to a different cadence and that it is allowed to slow down.

We believe beauty is not a luxury. That attention paid to things and to beings is the highest form of hospitality. That the guesthouse and the house of art are one and the same gesture: to truly welcome.

tablePg.s1p1: Each evening, the guests of Atlantis 12 gather around a common table. A unique meal, drawn from Essaouira's threefold culinary heritage - Andalusian, Amazigh and Sephardic - prepared with vegetables from the garden and fresh produce from the market.
tablePg.s1p2: Served in the patio in summer, by the fire in winter.
tablePg.s1p3: It is often here that the best conversations are born.
tablePg.s2Lead: A single menu, composed each evening according to the season and the inspiration of the moment.
tablePg.s2Price: €40 / person · drinks not included · by reservation · served at 8 p.m.
tablePg.s2Caption: Stuffed artichoke, octopus and Atlantic prawns
tablePg.s3p1: Jaouhara - crisp leaves, cream, almonds, cinnamon, orange blossom.
tablePg.s3p2: Before reigning over Moroccan tables, this dessert had its roots in the art of living of Al-Andalus. Crossing the Mediterranean with the Jewish and Muslim exiles of the 15th century, it reinvented itself in an Amazigh Morocco as a layered poem.
tablePg.s3p3: At Atlantis 12, we love telling the story on the plate.
tablePg.s4p1: In the morning, the table is set anew - msemen, baghrir, harcha, fresh bread, honey, jams, eggs from our hens, mint tea...
tablePg.s4p2: Included in the room rate · served from 9 a.m. to 11 a.m.

activitesPg.heroAlt: Sunset horseback ride on Essaouira beach - Atlantis 12
activitesPg.intro: Because a stay at Atlantis 12 doesn't end at the room, we have crafted each experience to extend the spirit of the house - between the thuya forest, the Atlantic and the Moroccan art of living. Some are lived right here, others take us further afield. All are by reservation.

house.title: Wellness massage
house.todo: Beneath the argan trees or on the terrace depending on the weather, our team offers a complete moment of relaxation. A treatment to enjoy from arrival - the rest of your stay will only be sweeter.

house.title: Intuitive painting workshop
house.todo: Lahcen Fikri opens his studio and his way of entering painting - through gesture, instinct, colour. No experience is required. None is even useful. You leave with a work you didn't expect - and that is entirely your own.

house.title: Camel ride
house.todo: From the Atlantis 12 patio, at the pace of the camel, the thuya forest opens onto a wild beach, far from everything. A picnic may punctuate the ride - a moment suspended between sky and ocean.

house.title: Yoga session
house.todo: On the terrace, with the thuya forest stretching into the distance. Indoors when the wind decides otherwise. Either way, time truly stops.

partners.title: Horseback rides
partners.todo: Argan forests, golden dunes, beach at sunset. A rare and gentle way to discover the surroundings.

partners.title: Surf, kitesurf, kitefoil, windsurf
partners.todo: The Atlantic is just steps away and Essaouira's wind is legendary. Beginners and advanced welcome - our partners adapt to your level.

partners.title: Quad or buggy excursions
partners.todo: Wild beaches and dunes as far as the eye can see. For those who love the feel of wind and space.

partners.title: Traditional hammam & treatments
partners.todo: A wellness interlude in an authentic hammam with scrubbing, beldi soap, clay mask. The Moroccan ritual in all its generosity.

partners.title: Electric motorbike tours
partners.todo: Quiet guided tours, at the pace of nature. An ecological and original way to discover the region.

activitesPg.customText: Every stay is different. If you have an activity in mind, an outing at sea, a meeting with an artisan or musician, a dinner under the stars... we will do everything to make it happen. Tell us what would truly delight you.
activitesPg.heroSubline: AT ATLANTIS 12 OR IN ESSAOUIRA - MASSAGE, YOGA, ART & NATURE

notes.darLawama: The most breathtaking Atlantic viewpoint in the region. We come as much for the eyes as for the plate. But for us, it is far more than that: for over twenty years we've had our table here, and long had our refuge here too. It is here, facing this ocean, that the idea of Essaouira took root, and with it, Atlantis 12.
